title: Christmas Day Clementine Sour
ingredients: 1 ½ ounces bourbon, preferably Elijah Craig 12-year-old
½ ounce Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao (or Grand Marnier or Triple Sec)
¼ ounce spiced brown sugar syrup
Juice of 1 clementine (about 1 ounce), plus ribbon of peel for garnish
½ teaspoon Luxardo Amaretto (enough to rinse inside of coupe glass) or Frangelico
directions: In a shaker filled with ice, combine the bourbon, curaçao, brown sugar syrup and clementine juice (and egg white, if using). Shake vigorously for 30 seconds.
In a chilled coupe glass, swirl enough amaretto to coat the inside. Strain shaken drink into coupe. Top with the bitters. Garnish with the ribbon of clementine peel.
3 cinnamon sticks, broken into smaller pieces
In a medium saucepan, combine all ingredients with 1 cup water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes until sugar has completely dissolved, stirring occasionally.
Remove pan from heat and let the syrup cool. Strain syrup into a clean jar; discard solids. May be refrigerated for a week.
